case_title: TERRANCE GILL VS. 655 CORBETT AVENUE CONDOMINIUM ASSOCIATION, INC.

docket_entries.description: STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE PRO TEM COMMISSIONER FILED BY GILL, TERRANCE 655 CORBETT AVENUE CONDOMINIUM ASSOCIATION, INC.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUN-01-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUN-01-2018 BY JUDGE PRO TEM ANDREA MCGARY. PLAINTIFF TERRANCE GILL IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT 655 CORBETT AVENUE CONDOMINIUM ASSOCIATION, INC. IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY CHRISTOPHER CURRY, BOARD MEMBER/SECRETARY. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: ANDREA MCGARY; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. 506
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-01-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GILL, TERRANCE IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT 655 CORBETT AVENUE CONDOMINIUM ASSOCIATION, INC. PURSUANT TO CIVIL CODE SECTION 5235(A), PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST FOR STATUTORY DAMAGES IS DENIED. PLAINTIFF HAS NOT ESTABLISHED THAT DEFENDANT'S RESPONSE TIME WAS UNREASONABLE. THIS COURT DOES NOT FIND DEFENDANT'S OPT OUT PRIVACY PROCEDURE AND PRIVACY REVIEW AND RECORDS RESPONSE TIME THEREAFTER TO BE UNREASONABLE BASED ON THE NATURE + SCOPE OF THE REQUESTED DUPLICATE COPIES AND MEMBER PRIVATE CONTRACT INFORMATION. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
